snippet.title: Must be Feng Shui - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishilst now on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4137830?utm_source=youtube
Must be Feng Shui is a relaxing puzzle game where you arrange furniture to create harmony in every home. Place items according to Feng Shui rules to unlock new levels, or design your own layouts and see if your dream space is truly in balance.
